messages:
Priya Raman: CascadeAI wants to onboard their custom adapter (cas-shim) onto cascade-13b-qlora. They're asking about fit in our catalog and any enterprise blockers.
Tom Blake: Do they need per-tenant KV? sequence lengths? streaming?
Priya Raman: AE said per-tenant KV yes, seq up to 1024, streaming partial responses for user typing.
Eliot Green: Quick notes: per-tenant KV will add ~6-10GB/replica for seq=1024 if using full KV. If we shard or use prefix-only cache it can be cheaper.
Naomi (Legal): Any customer data touching our logs or S3? CascadeAI requires log redaction + optional customer-managed keys.
Eliot Green: We can support CMK (customer KMS) on Private. Hosted supports envelope encryption but not HSM keywrap by default.
Tom Blake: Latency SLO ask: p99 < 220ms single-turn 256 tokens. Can they hit that on hosted?
Eliot Green: On p4d-like HW with quant-qlora variant and prefix cache: p99 ~200ms for 256 tokens. With per-tenant KV and streaming enabled p99 creeps to ~260ms unless we reduce batching.
Priya Raman: Sales needs a recommendation: Dedicated vs Hosted for this POC.
Eliot Green: Recommend Dedicated reserved pool (2-4 GPUs) to guarantee p99 if they insist on <220ms. Hosted ok if they accept fallback to cascade-7b-quant for bursts.
Sales Ops: Pricing inbound: their AE asked for delta $/token and a monthly reserved estimate for Dedicated.
Priya Raman: any quick ballpark?
Eliot Green: Base hosted cascade-13b-qlora ~ $0.00055/token. Per-tenant KV infra amortized ~+$0.00010/token at expected QPS. Quant-qlora lowers GPU cost by ~12% -> net +$0.00003. Dedicated reserved cost depends on commit; rough reserve adds ~$12k/mo for the pool, amortized per-token depends on usage.
Naomi (Legal): They requested HSM-backed keywrap and a data residency clause. HSM will be an enterprise add-on and needs legal review.
deploy-bot: compatibility-scan: cascadeai/cas-shim:latest -> ERROR: wheel built against python 3.9, runtime uses 3.11; recommend rebuild against redwood/python-base:3.11.
Tom Blake: AE will rebuild. Also they asked for a short POC checklist and expected signoff times.
Eliot Green: POC preflight: 1) adapter container/wheel (rebuilt) 2) sample workload + seq distribution 3) test corpus for quality evals 4) security questionnaire completed 5) target QPS and expected concurrency.
Priya Raman: Can we give an ETA for infra and security review?
Naomi (Legal): Security review (SOC2 + KMS/HSM extra) ~ 4-7 business days if no HSM, ~3-4 weeks if HSM requested.
Sales Ops: We'll draft customer-facing cost sheet + recommended deployment options.
Priya Raman: Quick snippet for the AE to run an internal latency probe (they can run against our sandbox):
```
curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_SANDBOX_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"cascade-13b-qlora-quant","input":"<test prompt>","stream":false}' | jq .timing
```
Eliot Green: Also note: enable prefix caching and shard KV by tenant id to avoid single huge KV store. We'll send exact RAM numbers after we model 1024 seq with their expected doc sizes.
Priya Raman: AE asked if we can do a short joint runbook/demo this week. I'm available Wed 10-10:30 PST.
Tom Blake: I can join. @Eliot any chance to prep a perf slide and cost table before then?
Eliot Green: I'll draft perf table + two deployment options (Dedicated reserved, Hosted with fallback) and upload to the deal.
Sales Ops: Attaching interim cost estimate and will include legal note about HSM pricing.
Priya Raman: Thanks team. I'll update CascadeAI and ask them to rebuild against 3.11 and resubmit adapter image. Reopen thread when image is ready. :thumbsup:
